verdict.rationale: Nothing in the first-party evidence documents a coverage map of supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, or local-currency settlement for connected accounts. The docs cover onboarding flows, payouts, and balances but not geographic or currency coverage. The only related community items are indirect: one reports confusion over which countries managed accounts support, one complains about missing international support, and one mentions international payouts. None of these shows a published coverage map.
